message: I remember the time the weather folks were predicting a big winter storm, and my daughter rolled her eyes at my "just in case" preparations. Fast forward to a foot of snow and her scrambling for hot chocolate and blankets while I was snug with my stash. She shot me that look, you know, the smug 'I told you so' moment. It was one of those times I felt like a sage, or maybe just slightly ahead of the game. Sometimes, being a bit prepared is just the ticket to cozying up through the storm! ❄️
